body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: A few shallow alcoves cut in pale mineral rock, linked by a narrow ledge. Unequal sleeping pockets, deep unlit mage recess, shared work shelf. Dry plain worn surfaces, no ornate arches or glittering crystals. COMPOSITION: Narrow ledge crosses in front at mid-height with lower storage nook, side section. COLOR SCRIPT: peat brown, dusty heather purple, gray-green cloth, dim peach lights. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
